_instructions: Risk criteria that decide whether a PR runs a differential Fortify Agentic Analyzer (FAA) scan.
Every matching rule adds its points once. FAA runs when the total is >= threshold.
Give a rule points >= threshold to make it force FAA on its own.
Each rule needs a name, points and exactly ONE condition:
label: matches when the PR has this label, e.g. "faa-required".
paths: list of case-insensitive regular expressions matched against changed, repository-relative paths (forward slashes).
declaration: {"field": "<PR body label>", "values": [...]} matches a PR body line '- <field>: <value>' (see .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md).
minChangedLines: matches when added + deleted lines across the PR are >= this number.
To extend: add, remove or re-weight rules, or change threshold. No code change is needed.
Keys starting with '_' are ignored. Test locally: node .github/scripts/faa-risk-adapter.mjs --help

rules.name: Significant or predominant AI assistance declared
